object.attr: as implemented: an agent repeating an add can tell the item is already there. Covers `create_document`, `add_parent_doc`, `define_attribute`, `add_attr_option` and `add_link`. A link is identified by its source and target, as the links file and `remove_link` identify it, so a second link type to the same target counts as existing; review Q26 proposed also matching the link type. Whether an existing issue tag gives `AlreadyExists` is open. The `error_type` values are this implementation's names, and a rewrite returns the same strings (review Q5).
object.description: If a write tool call asks to add a document, parent document, attribute or option that already exists, or a second link from one source to one target, the MCP server shall return `error_type` `AlreadyExists`.
